name: Ahmad Baba's exile
traveler: Ahmad Baba al-Timbukti, scholar of Timbuktu
summary: After Morocco conquers Songhay, the leading scholar of Timbuktu is put in chains with his family and marched across the Sahara to Marrakesh, losing his library of 1,600 books. In Marrakesh he teaches and writes until he is allowed home, and his works carry Timbuktu's learning to the Maghreb.

stops.note: The Moroccan pasha arrests the scholars of Sankore.
North across the desert by the salt road.
Prisoner of al-Mansur, then free to teach in the city's mosques.
Allowed home at last, after al-Mansur's death.
